questions.subtopic: two students talking about a new restaurant downtown and which dish to try
questions.context:
Woman: Have you tried that new Thai place that just opened downtown?
Man: Not yet, but everyone on my floor keeps talking about it. Is it really worth going?
Woman: Honestly, yeah. I went Friday and the green curry was incredible — and not too spicy.
Man: Oh, that's a relief. I'm honestly pretty terrible with spicy food.
Woman: Then the curry's perfect for you. Just ask them to make it mild.
Man: Good call.
Woman: You'll love it. Try to go this weekend, but get there early before the crowds.
questions.stem: What are the speakers mainly discussing?

options.A: A new restaurant and what to try
options.B: How to cook a spicy Thai curry
options.D: A cooking class they both attended

questions.subtopic: two friends discussing a movie one just saw — good twists but too long
questions.context:
Woman: Did you end up seeing that new mystery film everyone's talking about?
Man: I did, last night. The plot twists were absolutely brilliant, honestly.
Woman: Everyone's been raving about those twists. So you'd recommend it, then?
Man: Well, sort of. The twists were great, but it dragged on for nearly three hours.
Woman: Three hours?
Man: Right. By the end I kept checking the time. Great story, just way too long.
Woman: That's a shame. A tighter cut would've made it perfect.
questions.stem: What is the man's overall opinion of the film?

options.A: It was boring from start to finish
options.B: It was excellent but far too long
options.C: The twists were confusing and weak
options.D: It was the best film he's seen

questions.subtopic: two friends sharing cooking tips while grocery shopping
questions.context:
Woman: Do you know how to pick a ripe avocado? Mine are always rock hard.
Man: Oh, easy — just press near the stem. If it gives a little, it's ready.
Woman: Huh, I never knew that.
Man: Yeah. And for tomatoes, go by smell — a ripe one smells sweet at the stem.
Woman: That's such a good trick. I usually just grab whatever looks reddest.
Man: Give the smell test a try. You'll notice the difference right away.
Woman: I definitely will. My salads have been so bland lately.
questions.stem: What are the two friends mainly talking about?

options.A: Which grocery store has better prices
options.B: A recipe they plan to cook together
options.C: How to tell when produce is ripe
